Add Quorum, ten distributed-systems examples, and property proofs to jvmcontract
Add Crosscut, eleven Spring Boot examples verified by jvmcontract
Add Mica, twelve JVM-kernel examples, and four jvmcontract fixes
Add feature-loop.sh to grow jvmcontract unattended
Add array properties with JML quantifiers, and three Mica examples
Add generalized JML quantifiers, witness shrinking, and four Mica examples
Add throws clauses to property proofs, and two Mica examples
Add JML \old to property proofs, and two Mica examples
Cap the feature loop's memory with a systemd scope
Add regression proofs over arrays
Check liveness and refinement in TLA+ models, and two 2PC examples
Model Raft leader election around the role machine, with action properties, and three examples
Check the Raft election model under three configurations: an inductive invariant and four servers under symmetry, with two examples
Check the Raft election model for liveness under fairness, a fourth configuration, with two new examples and 063 rechecked
Check that the Raft kernel's exception is unreachable and the two-phase-commit invariant inductive, with three new examples
Generate the Raft vote rule into the election model as a second operator, add a logs configuration for the election restriction, with three new examples
Report what a model-checking verdict rests on: TLC coverage read back per contract row, a vacuous label, and three new examples
Check the circuit-breaker model for liveness under fairness, a second configuration, with three new examples
Check the idempotent receiver's expiry rows under a second configuration in which the record's time to live can pass, with three new examples
Check the Raft role machine's stale-reply rows under a sixth configuration in which a vote reply waits on the wire, with three new examples
Check the Raft paper's run-wide claims, one leader per term and one vote per server per term, with history variables under a seventh configuration, with three new examples
Let the two-phase-commit coordinator crash and restart on a recovery rule generated from its own contract, under two more configurations, with three new examples
Hold the Java two-phase-commit nodes to the model by trace validation under a fifth configuration, with three new examples
Let the two-phase-commit participants crash and restart on a rule generated from their own contract, under two more configurations, with three new examples
Model Raft log replication with the follower's append rule and the leader's commit rule as two more generated operators, under two configurations, with three new examples
Check Raft log replication for liveness under fairness, a third configuration with three temporal properties, with three new examples
Generate the leader's reply rule into the Raft replication model as a third operator and let replies arrive late, twice or never under a fourth configuration, with three new examples
Record session traces

Ship the JDK models inside jvmcontract: the boxing caches, a generated Character.digit and java.nio.charset, on JBMC's class path and in the interpreter, replacing the models-library fork (verification pending)
Add the tool's own bounded model checker: the harness executed symbolically over bit-vectors and decided by a bundled CaDiCaL, behind --engine native and auto (verification pending)
Let the feature loop be stopped after the current cycle by typing stop in its terminal
Give the feature loop a cycle count, adjustable while it runs, in place of the stop command
Add verification-loop.sh: a fresh Sonnet session runs /run-verification whenever the queue has work, and the loop watches for new jobs in between
Add a spring prompt to the feature loop: make jvmcontract more useful to expert Spring Boot developers

Add boundary contracts (B12): a Spring Boot module's routes, listeners, schedules, bean definitions and configuration keys, the advice on each bean, and the places where an annotation does not do what it says, read from the class files (verification pending)

Add wire types to boundary contracts: the JSON shape of each request, response and message as Jackson encodes it, with checks for a subtype missing from @JsonSubTypes, a type id that is a class name and a persistence type on the wire (verification pending)
Record verification results for 8 jobs: 6 passed, Mica rerun and Example 109 revisited failed
Resubmit the Quorum examples rerun at the current commit (verification pending)

Add the configuration block to boundary contracts: the keys a module's classes read, the keys its application files set and the keys the class path's metadata declares, cross-checked, with ! lines for a key nothing binds, a deprecated key and a value of the wrong type (verification pending)
Record session traces

Add validation checks to boundary contracts: the constraints inside a wire type's properties, and ! lines for a nested type no @Valid leads into, a body taken without @Valid, a group a @Valid or @Validated leaves out and a constraint on a type its validator cannot handle (verification pending)

Add the activation block to boundary contracts: what switches each kind of annotation on (an @Enable annotation on a configuration in scope, an auto-configuration whose conditions hold, a Bean Validation provider), with a ! line for a family nothing enables (verification pending)

Add the stored types block to boundary contracts: the shape of each Spring Data MongoDB document as the mapper stores it, and a ! line for every query, update, index, sort, projection or @Query string that names a field the document does not have (verification pending)

Add reach lines to boundary contracts: under each entry point what it reads, writes, sends, calls and publishes, from a call graph over the application's own classes, with a ! line for a GET with side effects and a read-only transaction that writes (verification pending)
